title: The Late Orchard
author: L. M. Vasquez
blurb: Jude Almeida, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
